page.layout: One page of text, single column. Above the text a row of printed vignettes (ornament, not transcribed). Title in large capitals at top of column; then a paragraph beginning with a large woodcut initial Q. Below the text the signature line "A 2" and the catchword "CANTICI" at right. Page number "3" at upper right, outside the text block. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: CANTICUM CANTICORUM SALOMONIS.
main_text.p: QUod ex Hebræis pro primo versu Lxx. reddidere, hoc Vulgatus rejecit in titulum hujus libelli, qui specie Dramatis ordinatus, ut loquitur Hieron. personarum imitatione contexitur. Mirificè autem Regum sapientissimus Salomon divinitus inspiratus Christi sponsi & Ecclesiæ sponsæ laudes, sacri amoris gratiam & æterni commercii cecinit Sacramenta sub persona pastoris, ast Regio sanguine procreati castam puellam congenerem sibi desponsatam maximè, sed casté adamantis. Unde libellus hic vocatur Canticum Canticorum, id est, Canticum excellentissimum, quo nihil suavius, nihilque divinius. Quia verò pluribus constat odis, inscribitur à benè multis Cantica in plurali.

page.notes: Woodcut initial Q is joined to "Uod" as "QUod". Printed as "Quod" with the large initial. Catchword and signature are at the foot. The title lines are set in large spaced capitals; the heading is given as one head. The vignette row at the top is decorative and not transcribed.
